requestSummary: Revise jessy-graph from a Dockerized runtime to a host-native local LangGraph and MCP service. Codex workers execute directly on the host and reuse the host Codex configuration and authentication under /root/.codex.
approvedInScope: Replace the active Docker and Compose runtime with a host-native service
Keep the bearer-authenticated Streamable HTTP MCP interface for localhost and trusted LAN clients on port 8003
Reuse host Codex CLI, config.toml, auth.json, custom provider, and session storage without copying credentials into the project
Preserve the approved task DAG, durable LangGraph execution, internal mirrors and worktrees, deterministic validation, and immutable artifacts
Allow up to five conflict-free Codex workers while serializing integration and high-pressure verification
Revise the architecture specification, implementation plan, tests, and operational setup to match the host-native runtime
approvedOutOfScope: Automatic merge into host repositories, push, deployment, migration, or production changes
Copying or logging API keys, bearer tokens, or auth.json contents
sourceEvidence: User explicitly replaced the container strategy with host-native orchestration using the same host Codex configuration
User explicitly requested restarting grill-me and the Codex project workflow
User explicitly requested durable Mem0 recall across context compaction
Previous production diagnostics proved host Codex and the custom Responses relay work while container execution is blocked by relay and sandbox incompatibilities
constraints: Do not use --strict-config because the working host config contains an unknown field
Do not use --output-schema because the relay rejects it; validate --output-last-message locally with CodexResultV1
Bind MCP to 0.0.0.0:8003 but allow only authenticated localhost and trusted LAN clients through exact Host/Origin policy
Do not expose credential contents through logs, state, artifacts, MCP responses, or repository files
Do not let worker Codex recursively invoke the Jessy Graph MCP orchestrator
Do not modify host source worktrees; execute in internal worktrees from immutable Git bases
Delete only resolved Jessy Graph Docker code, container, and volumes during implementation; preserve unrelated user changes
